No support. `<-` is already an infix operator (frontdoor.rs:2007) used by `with`; special forms decode in src/compiler2/quoted_function.rs:470-486. Generators whose pattern does not match skip the element (Elixir). into: uses Collectable; reduce: threads an accumulator with `acc -> ...` clauses. Used at distill lines 24, 35, 44, 84, 103, 108, 161, 180, 248, 277.

## Design review (2026-10-17)
Fold: for is surface sugar, so it lives in src/compiler2/source_sugar.rs beside pipe, capture and lambda (rewrite_source_sugar :14), rewriting to Enum.reduce + Collectable calls with generated_variable hygiene (:450). No new Expr variant, no lowering arm, no free-name analysis change.; Proposal page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-sc8.17.html (2026-11-08, APPROVED 2026-11-08 (user: Proceed)): one rewrite rule in source_sugar.rs; generators -> Enum.reduce + case with a skip arm only for refutable patterns (an irrefutable pattern would raise type/redundant-clause); filters -> if; plain -> Enum.reverse; into: -> Collectable.into + :done; reduce: -> case acc do clauses end. uniq: and bitstring generators are loud errors (tickets proposed). Blocked by .20 (pattern both sides) and .12. Predicted frontier after landing: line 103 MapSet.new (.15).
